title: Niagara Falls: Boat Cruise, Journey Behind Falls, & Skylon Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Bus does not have a ramp for wheelchair
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a guided small group tour of the Canadian side of Niagara Falls for an unforgettable tour experience.

Tour Highlights:

Whirlpool Observation Deck : Enjoy views of the Whirlpool Rapids

Skylon Tower: Take in panoramic views of the Falls.

Journey Behind the Falls: Explore tunnels and feel the cascading water.

Hornblower Cruise : End with a thrilling cruise to the base of the Falls .

Seasonal Adjustments: From December to May 5th, Boat Cruise is closed and replaced with Niagara Power Station or the Butterfly Conservatory
